cited_by.title: Braids, twists and extensions: tension, how long, itch

record.population: 197 Ghanaian women, mean age 23, hairline status scored on the Marginal Traction Alopecia Score
record.finding: 40.6% had hairline recession consistent with traction alopecia. More than two high-frequency heat-styling sessions a month was associated with higher odds (adjusted odds ratio 5.65, 95% CI 1.35-23.62). Keeping one hairstyle for over 6 weeks showed higher estimated odds that were not significant (1.81, 95% CI 0.59-5.60).
